# functions 
```{R}
# ============================================================
# Multivariate brms pipeline function
# - loops over tau outcomes  
# - fits the mv model (ptau + tauROI + CDRSB)
# - saves: fit .rds, summary text, Bayes R2 CSV, pp_check PNGs,
#          and diagnostics (plot(fit), trace plots, pairs)
# ============================================================

# save pp check
save_plot_png <- function(p, path, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(filename = path, plot = p, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi)
}

# save model fit summary
write_summary_txt <- function(fit, path) {
  sm <- summary(fit)
  txt <- capture.output(print(sm))
  writeLines(txt, con = path)
}

# save model r2
write_bayesR2_csv <- function(fit, path) {
  r2 <- bayes_R2(fit)
  r2_df <- as.data.frame(r2)
  r2_df$resp <- rownames(r2_df)
  r2_df <- r2_df %>% select(resp, everything())
  write_csv(r2_df, path)
}

# save trace plot plot(model) for brms
save_diag_plots <- function(fit, outdir, prefix = "diag") { 
  png(file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_brms_plot.png")), width = 2200, height = 1400, res = 200)
  print(plot(fit))
  dev.off()

  all_vars <- variables(fit)

  pars_sd_slope <- grep("^sd_ID__.*time_to_baseline$", all_vars, value = TRUE)
  pars_cor_slope <- grep("^cor_ID__.*time_to_baseline__.*time_to_baseline$", all_vars, value = TRUE)
  #pars_rescor <- grep("^rescor__", all_vars, value = TRUE)

  if (length(pars_sd_slope) + length(pars_cor_slope) >0){ #+ length(pars_rescor)  
    png(file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_trace_keypars.png")), width = 2400, height = 1600, res = 200)
    print(
      mcmc_plot(
        fit,
        type = "trace",
        pars = unique(c(pars_sd_slope, pars_cor_slope))#, pars_rescor
      )
    )
    dev.off()
  }

  # Pairs plot for a small subset (avoid huge plots)
  sel <- c(head(pars_sd_slope, 3), head(pars_cor_slope, 3))
  sel <- sel[nzchar(sel)]
  if (length(sel) >= 2) {
    png(file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_pairs_keypars.png")), width = 2400, height = 2000, res = 200)
    print(pairs(fit, pars = sel))
    dev.off()
  }

  # Divergences count (text)  with cmdstanr backend
  nd <- tryCatch({
    np <- nuts_params(fit)
    sum(np$Parameter == "divergent__" & np$Value == 1)
  }, error = function(e) NA_integer_)
  writeLines(paste0("n_divergent = ", nd), con = file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_divergences.txt")))
}

save_pp_checks <- function(fit, outdir, resp_names, prefix = "ppcheck") {
  for (resp in resp_names) {
    p <- pp_check(fit, resp = resp)
    save_plot_png(
      p,
      file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_", resp, ".png")),
      width = 8.5, height = 5.5, dpi = 300
    )
  }
}

# mrmm fit
fit_mv_for_tau <- function(
  df,
  outcomes,
  result_root = "mv_ptau_results", 
  include_cov_outcome  = FALSE,
  include_cov_cdr  = FALSE,
  # brms sampling args
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  adapt_delta = 0.995, max_treedepth = 15,
  seed = 2333
) {
  dir.create(result_root, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)



build_bf_outcome <- function(outcome_y) {

  # -------------------------
  # choose time variable
  # -------------------------
  time_var <- dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("centiloid", outcome_y, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "amy_date_to_baseline",
    grepl("CDRSB", outcome_y, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "cdr_date_to_baseline",
    grepl("ptau", outcome_y,      ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "ptau_date_to_baseline",
    TRUE                                              ~ "tau_date_to_baseline"
  )

  # -------------------------
  # fixed effects string
  # -------------------------
  fixed_part <- if (include_cov_outcome) {
    paste0("1 + ", time_var, " + age_bl + sex + educ + apoe4_status")
  } else {
    paste0("1 + ", time_var)
  }

  # -------------------------
  # full formula
  # -------------------------
  bf(
    stats::as.formula(
      paste0(
        outcome_y,
        " ~ ",
        fixed_part,
        " + (1 + ", time_var, " | p | ID)"
      )
    )
  )
}

  build_bf_cdr <- function() {
    if (include_cov_cdr) {
      bf(
        CDRSB ~ 1 + cdr_date_to_baseline + age_bl + sex + educ + apoe4_status +
          (1 + cdr_date_to_baseline | p | ID)
      )
    } else {
      bf(
        CDRSB ~ 1 + cdr_date_to_baseline +
          (1 + cdr_date_to_baseline | p | ID)
      )
    }
  }
  build_bf_ptau <- function() {
    if (include_cov_cdr) {
      bf(
        ptau ~ 1 + ptau_date_to_baseline + age_bl + sex + educ + apoe4_status +
          (1 + ptau_date_to_baseline | p | ID)
      )
    } else {
      bf(
        ptau ~ 1 + ptau_date_to_baseline +
          (1 + ptau_date_to_baseline | p | ID)
      )
    }
  }

  # store a run log
  run_log <- list()

  for (outcome_y in outcomes) {
    ttag <- outcome_y
    outdir <- file.path(result_root, ttag)
    dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

    message("\n============================")
    message("Fitting mv model for tau outcome: ", outcome_y)
    message("Output dir: ", outdir)
    message("============================\n")

    # Build brms formulas
    bf_outcome  <- build_bf_outcome(outcome_y)
    bf_cdr  <- build_bf_cdr()
    bf_ptau <- build_bf_ptau()

    # Fit (wrapped with tryCatch so loop continues)
    fit <- tryCatch({
      brm(
        bf_outcome + bf_ptau + set_rescor(FALSE),
        data = df,
        family = gaussian(),
        chains = chains, cores = cores, iter = iter, warmup = warmup,
        backend = backend,
        control = list(adapt_delta = adapt_delta, max_treedepth = max_treedepth),
        seed = seed,
        file = NULL # prevent brms auto-caching unless you want it
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      msg <- paste0("ERROR fitting tau outcome ", outcome_y, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
      message(msg)
      writeLines(msg, con = file.path(outdir, "ERROR_fit.txt"))
      return(NULL)
    })

    if (is.null(fit)) {
      run_log[[tau_tag]] <- list(status = "error")
      next
    }

    # ---- Save fit ----
    fit_path <- file.path(outdir, paste0("fit_mv_", ttag, ".rds"))
    saveRDS(fit, fit_path)

    # ---- Save summary ----
    write_summary_txt(fit, file.path(outdir, paste0("summary_",ttag, ".txt")))

    # ---- Bayes R2 ----
    write_bayesR2_csv(fit, file.path(outdir, paste0("bayesR2_", ttag, ".csv")))

    # # ---- pp_checks (resp names in this fitted model) ----
    # # brms internal response names are often stripped of underscores.
    # # We find the response names programmatically so pp_check doesn't fail.
    # # Get response names from the fitted object:
    # resp_names <- tryCatch({
    #   # brms stores response names in fit$data; but internal resp strings for pp_check are in 'resp' info
    #   # safest: use fit$resp_vars, but not always present; instead parse variables() for "sigma_<resp>"
    #   v <- variables(fit)
    #   sigs <- grep("^sigma_", v, value = TRUE)
    #   sub("^sigma_", "", sigs)
    # }, error = function(e) character(0))
    # 
    # # If that fails or is empty, fall back to the actual data column names (may not match)
    # if (length(resp_names) == 0) resp_names <- c("ptau", tau_tag, "CDRSB")
    # 
    # save_pp_checks(fit, outdir, resp_names = resp_names, prefix = "ppcheck")
    # 
    # # ---- Diagnostics plots ----
    # save_diag_plots(fit, outdir, prefix = "diagnostics")
    # 
    # # ---- Record log ----
    # run_log[[tau_tag]] <- list(
    #   status = "ok",
    #   fit_rds = fit_path,
    #   n_obs = nrow(df_long),
    #   n_id = dplyr::n_distinct(df_long$ID),
    #   resp_names = resp_names
    # )

    # (optional) free memory if looping many models
    rm(fit); gc()
  }

  invisible(run_log)
}
```

# extracting and saving the ouput 
```{R}
 
# -------------------------
# helper: same time-var logic as your model builder
# -------------------------
get_time_var <- function(outcome_y) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("centiloid", outcome_y, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "amy_date_to_baseline",
    grepl("ptau", outcome_y,      ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "ptau_date_to_baseline",
    grepl("CDRSB", outcome_y,      ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "cdr_date_to_baseline",
    TRUE                                              ~ "tau_date_to_baseline"
  )
}

# brms tends to strip underscores/punct in printed resp labels (as you saw: mtlnohippocampustau)
sanitize_resp <- function(x) {
  # keep letters/numbers only; lower
  tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", x))
}

# summarize draws
summ_draws <- function(x) {
  tibble(
    mean   = mean(x),
    median = median(x),
    q2.5   = quantile(x, 0.025),
    q97.5  = quantile(x, 0.975)
  )
}

# -------------------------
# core extractor for ONE fitted model
# -------------------------
extract_mrmm_corrs_one <- function(fit, outcome_y) {

  time_var <- get_time_var(outcome_y)

  # VarCorr draws
  vc <- brms::VarCorr(fit, summary = FALSE)

  if (is.null(vc$ID) || is.null(vc$ID$cor)) {
    stop("No group-level correlation array found under VarCorr(fit)$ID$cor. Did the model include (1 + time | p | ID)?")
  }

  cor_arr <- vc$ID$cor
  labs <- dimnames(cor_arr)[[2]]
  if (is.null(labs)) stop("Correlation array has no dimnames; cannot match parameters robustly.")

  # normalize labels for matching
  labs_norm <- sanitize_resp(labs)
  out_norm  <- sanitize_resp(outcome_y)
  cdr_norm  <- sanitize_resp("ptau")

  # Find the specific effect labels in the correlation matrix
  # Outcome intercept: contains outcome resp + "Intercept"
  out_int_idx <- which(str_detect(labs_norm, out_norm) & str_detect(labs, "Intercept"))

  # Outcome slope: contains outcome resp + time_var
  out_slope_idx <- which(str_detect(labs_norm, out_norm) & str_detect(labs, fixed(time_var)))

  # CDR slope: contains CDRSB resp + cdr_date_to_baseline
  cdr_slope_idx <- which(str_detect(labs_norm, cdr_norm) & str_detect(labs, fixed("ptau_date_to_baseline")))

  # sanity checks
  if (length(cdr_slope_idx) != 1) {
    stop("Could not uniquely identify CDR slope term. Matches found: ", paste(labs[cdr_slope_idx], collapse = " | "))
  }
  if (length(out_slope_idx) != 1) {
    stop("Could not uniquely identify outcome slope term for ", outcome_y,
         ". Matches found: ", paste(labs[out_slope_idx], collapse = " | "))
  }
  if (length(out_int_idx) != 1) {
    stop("Could not uniquely identify outcome intercept term for ", outcome_y,
         ". Matches found: ", paste(labs[out_int_idx], collapse = " | "))
  }

  # pull posterior draws of correlations
  # cor_arr dims: iterations x K x K
  draw_slope_slope <- cor_arr[, out_slope_idx, cdr_slope_idx]
  draw_int_cdrslope <- cor_arr[, out_int_idx, cdr_slope_idx]

  # summarize
  ss <- summ_draws(draw_slope_slope) %>%
    mutate(
      outcome = outcome_y,
      time_var = time_var,
      corr_type = "corr(outcome_slope, ptau_slope)",
      lhs = labs[out_slope_idx],
      rhs = labs[cdr_slope_idx]
    )

  is <- summ_draws(draw_int_cdrslope) %>%
    mutate(
      outcome = outcome_y,
      time_var = time_var,
      corr_type = "corr(outcome_intercept, ptau_slope)",
      lhs = labs[out_int_idx],
      rhs = labs[cdr_slope_idx]
    )

  bind_rows(ss, is)
}

# -------------------------
# run extractor over ALL saved fits
# -------------------------
extract_mrmm_corrs_all <- function(result_root = "mv_ptau_results") {

  fit_paths <- list.files(
    path = result_root,
    pattern = "^fit_mv_.*\\.rds$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  if (length(fit_paths) == 0) stop("No fit .rds found under: ", result_root)

  # outcome name from filename: fit_mv_<outcome>.rds
  outcomes_from_path <- sub("^fit_mv_", "", tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(fit_paths)))

  map2_dfr(fit_paths, outcomes_from_path, function(fp, out) {
    message("Reading: ", fp)
    fit <- readRDS(fp)

    # protect loop; keep going if one model is weird
    tryCatch({
      extract_mrmm_corrs_one(fit, out) %>% mutate(fit_path = fp)
    }, error = function(e) {
      tibble(
        outcome = out,
        time_var = get_time_var(out),
        corr_type = NA_character_,
        lhs = NA_character_,
        rhs = NA_character_,
        mean = NA_real_, median = NA_real_, q2.5 = NA_real_, q97.5 = NA_real_,
        fit_path = fp,
        error = conditionMessage(e)
      )
    })
  })
}

# -------------------------
# EXECUTE
# -------------------------
mrmm_corr_tbl <- extract_mrmm_corrs_all("mv_ptau_results")

# keep successful rows
mrmm_corr_tbl_ok <- mrmm_corr_tbl %>%
  filter(is.na(error)) %>%
  arrange(corr_type, desc(mean))

print(mrmm_corr_tbl_ok)

# optional save
write.csv(mrmm_corr_tbl, file = paste0("mrmm_full_ptau_correlations_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
